answer: Admission auctions block fake identities: each epoch auctions limited identity slots; only the top sealed bids win entry, so no attacker can grow a vine of free accounts from one kernel of capital. Prices rise as the pool of open slots shrinks. 100 fakes at 5 POA each cost 500 POA for 200 POA of reward, a 300 POA loss, while one honest agent pays 5 POA once. Every bid is public, so each fake leaves a ripple reviewers can trace.
